column1: # Naming pass: Rust path renames, one regex per line, applied in order.
#   SCOPE<TAB>REGEX<TAB>REPLACEMENT      (SCOPE: a path prefix the file must start with)
# Used by scripts/build/rename_paths.py (the pass itself) and by
# Grouped imports (use crate::{a::X, b::Y}) are split per item before the rules run.
# relative paths the move of constraints/fp8/service broke
# ffi: the program table is every family's, not DeepSeek V4's
# loader: families/ and formats/ are the module paths; long family ids
# transport/api: the expert client and the OpenAI API under their own names
# transport: the Spark expert client serves every family
# daemon: Spark rank topology is shared
# plan families and expert geometries by long family id
# api: chat templates under openai::chat::<family id>
# N10: shared native C symbols and headers lose v41 (V4.1-only symbols keep it)
